public_source.scientific_claim_boundary: Public real GIS import and topological reachability demonstration only. Any planning run must label synthetic overlays and must not claim operational validation.

synthetic_overlay.scheduling_coordinates: Synthetic grid x=sorted_node_index*0.01km,y=0; not source geometry or road distance.
synthetic_overlay.loads: Only two synthetic consumers, 1kW each; node aggregate and distributed generation set to zero.
synthetic_overlay.branches: R=X=0.1ohm/km times declared line length; zero-length switch/regulator equivalents; limit=1000kW.
synthetic_overlay.regulator: UNREMT represented as a conducting edge only; tap/voltage regulation not modeled.
synthetic_overlay.switches: P_N_OPE normal A/F assumed as current state; all declared maneuverable; 0.1h aggregate duration.
synthetic_overlay.equipment_in_service: All extracted MV elements assumed in service for this computational fixture.
synthetic_overlay.intervention: First lexicographic closed declared switch isolating at least two normally energized PACs; no transfer.
synthetic_overlay.portfolio: Two mandatory synthetic services, 1h/1.5h, one ELEC and one PRUNE crew, one day, explicit materials.
synthetic_overlay.selection_is_not_benefit_tuning: Selection uses topology and stable ordering only; no performance target or seed search.
synthetic_overlay.limits: Single CTMT excerpt with open boundary stubs; no real UC, LV, actual switching order, AC load flow, or Cemig data.
